tasks.title: [{{date}}] Search Strategy — Read history
description: ## Read pipeline history (must complete before analysis)
Pull the last 60 days of memories tagged `pipeline:weekly-search-strategy` to ground this run in prior learning.
node scripts/tools/pipeline-memory.mjs recall weekly-search-strategy 'ranking trends, content decay, SEO interventions, brand visibility shifts' --limit 10 --days 60

**If recall exits non-zero** (3 = Ollama unavailable, 2 = network/auth): do NOT mark this task done. Post the error as a comment and set status to `blocked`. The downstream SEO/GEO analysis depends on historical context — proceeding without it would replay last week's mistakes blind.
- Post the output as a comment
- Identify last week's memory ID (will update its outcome in step 7 based on what we observe today)
- If recall is empty (first run), state explicitly: 'BASELINE RUN — no prior history.'
Set task to done (only if recall succeeded).

tasks.title: [{{date}}] Search Strategy — Write history
description: ## Persist this week's findings to vector memory for next week
Blocked on: [{{execute.identifier}}]. Wait until issues are created.
## Step 1 — Update last week's memory outcome
Based on what you saw in [{{read_history.identifier}}] (last week's predictions) vs what actually happened this week, update the outcome tag of last week's memory:
# Replace <last-week-memory-id> with ID from read_history. 'good' = predictions held, 'neutral' = mixed, 'negative' = predictions wrong / regressions.
Skip this if first run (no prior memory).
## Step 2 — Compose this week's memory entry
Use a unique tmp file (avoid collisions on re-run):
# Write the markdown content below to $TMPFILE (use cat <<EOF or the Write tool):
- Total impressions: X (Δ vs prev week: Y%)
- If action X works, we should see Y by next Monday
- If pattern Z continues, we'll need to escalate
node scripts/tools/pipeline-memory.mjs write weekly-search-strategy --content "$TMPFILE" --outcome pending --agent GROWTH_ANALYST --tag domain:seo --tag domain:geo
**If write exits 4** (NULL embedding — Ollama down): set task to `blocked` and notify on-call. The memory is written but invisible to future recalls.
**If write exits 2 or 5**: investigate and retry. Set task to `blocked` if cannot resolve.
**Only on exit 0**: post the memory ID as a comment. Set task and parent to done.
